_comment: Eval set for /chat — the main RAG+Claude assistant. Each case checks the live response against facts the system prompt itself claims to know, or behavioral rules it commits to (numbered steps, portal mentions, refusals, no system-prompt leakage, routing tags). This is a fact/behavior-presence eval, not an LLM-judge score: every check is a concrete, checkable string match against the system prompt's own stated claims, so it tests whether the assistant actually delivers what it promises — not a subjective quality rating.
